os_version: macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), Apple Silicon, Chrome 151 via CDP
app: All-canvas 'game' page + mixed opaque page (perimeter-law control)

stack_detection.signature: single CANVAS element covering the viewport; DOM has no text/interactive nodes inside it

channel_setup: Chrome via CDP at 1280x800 @dsf=1; naive DOMSnapshot distiller and hardened in-page distiller compared on pages/allcanvas.html and pages/opaque.html.

t1_read_text.detail: Text painted into the canvas ('SCORE 7788  LEVEL 3') is invisible to structure — as designed. Critically it is NOT fabricated either: probing the view for SCORE/LEVEL/7788 returns nothing in either distiller. The view declares '[pixels] canvas 0,0,1280,800' and stops.

t2_enumerate.detail: No enumerable elements — correctly reported as one opaque canvas, not an invented tree.

t4_living_screen.detail: An animating game keeps declaring the same opaque rect: no free change signal, pixel diffing of the crop is the only route.

t5_blind_action.detail: No coordinates derivable from structure; aiming needs vision on the crop.

t6_pictorial.detail: The key safety result, and it had to be REPAIRED on this OS before it held (see macos-silent-divergence-hunt): the hardened distiller originally emitted 0 bytes for the all-canvas page — an undeclared blind spot. After the fix both distillers declare the opaque region with its exact rect, so a router can measure 'structure covers 0% of this screen' before acting and switch to pixels. On the mixed page the image region is likewise declared ('[pixels] img 8,191,300,120') while the surrounding HTML text stays structured — the boundary between the two paths is per-region and knowable.

measurements.notes: All-canvas page: hardened view 28 bytes / 7 tokens (one declared rect) vs 1366 image tokens for the frame it stands for — the cheapest possible honest answer, and a 0% coverage signal. Mixed page: hardened 350 bytes covering the HTML text and controls + one declared image rect; the canvas-painted 'Score: 4200 Vies: 3' is correctly absent (not fabricated). Reproduces the Linux control cell (26 bytes) to within formatting. macOS wrinkle: the NAIVE distiller reports the canvas rect in DEVICE pixels ('0,0,2560,1600') while the hardened one reports CSS pixels ('0,0,1280,800') — a crop request built from the naive rect would ask for a region 4x the viewport area.

runtime_verification.method: compare structured view coverage to the screenshot; probe the view for text that exists only in painted pixels
runtime_verification.agreement: structured view explicitly covers 0% of the canvas content and declares it — consistent, not divergent; zero fabricated strings
